authorization.note: E0 non-patient compatibility inference only. E1, E3, E4, and E5 remain separate staged decisions.

primary_question: staged synthetic-to-real-EHR transfer and failure localization

contrasts.factor: instruction tuning within Qwen2.5 small class
contrasts.interpretation: Separates the instruction-tuned artifact from its matched 1.5B pretrained counterpart; format and conditional semantics remain separate outcomes.

contrasts.factor: instruction tuning within Qwen2.5 medium class
contrasts.interpretation: Separates the instruction-tuned artifact from its matched 3B pretrained counterpart; format and conditional semantics remain separate outcomes.

contrasts.factor: approximate size class within Qwen2.5 pretrained models
contrasts.interpretation: Tests the small-versus-medium size class within one pretrained family; it does not estimate a continuous scaling law.

contrasts.factor: approximate size class within Qwen2.5 instruction-tuned models
contrasts.interpretation: Tests the small-versus-medium size class within one instruction-tuned family; it does not estimate a continuous scaling law.

contrasts.factor: general versus medical post-training package at approximately 4B
contrasts.interpretation: Matched-parent-family IT comparison, but not a pure causal effect of medical pretraining because the complete post-training packages may differ.
Descriptive current-release sensitivity; architecture, data, and post-training changes are not isolated.

contrasts.factor: older controlled Qwen family versus contemporary general reference
contrasts.interpretation: Deployment-oriented descriptive comparison only; architecture, modality, release age, and post-training are confounded.

provisional_decisions.panel: six core models plus two contemporary E0 references
provisional_decisions.e3_context_policy: complete note under shared cap; shared span window only when overlength

model_change_policy.before_held_out_scoring: Technical E0 substitution is allowed only after the documented repair budget is exhausted.
model_change_policy.low_performance: A model that loads and completes requests is retained even when semantic or schema performance is poor.
model_change_policy.after_held_out_scoring: Any panel change creates a new exploratory benchmark version and cannot replace the approved primary results.

claim_boundary: E0 is a technical compatibility gate, not a semantic model leaderboard.
